objective: Verify that an existing, normally working desktop Codex login can run a bounded official Codex worker and a separate review invocation, without transferring credentials.

budget.scope_note: Counts adapter invocations, not vendor-internal model/tool calls or currency.

allowed: Read the pinned public source and official installation documentation.
Use existing official ChatGPT-plan login on the actual worker host.
Create isolated local task artifacts and use only synthetic input.
Locate an existing Node 24+ and official native Codex executable; if absent, install official portable/local packages only inside an already authorized task directory without administrator changes.
forbidden: Do not sign out of or replace a working desktop session.
Do not manually read, copy, upload or rewrite credential files, tokens or verification codes; only the official client may use its own existing login.
Do not create accounts, keys, new access grants, subscriptions or paid API connections.
Do not enable API-key mode, override model selection, weaken sandbox/config guards, start services or alter cron.
Do not use private documents, personal project goals or account exports as test inputs.
Do not bypass prerequisites or report a demo as authenticated inference.

execution: Read the pinned source repository AGENTS.md and this task README before executing.
Inspect the input UTF-8 bytes, compute SHA-256, and retain the task identity for the real desktop receipt.
Inspect the supplied probe and module fingerprint manifest, use a separate checkout at source_commit, and verify executable module hashes.

Run the live probe once with the existing official native Codex binary and a fresh private output path. Stop after any preflight or first invocation failure. Do not run the synthetic mode as a substitute.
Producer computes sum 17; a different Codex worker ID independently reviews it. Both use the same provider; this does not prove cross-vendor independence.

Return a sanitized actual desktop receipt with the exact task identity, read source version, stages, exit code and limited evidence. Do not fabricate a desktop receipt from a cloud/demonstration runtime.
acceptance: Actual producer and reviewer invocations both returned valid protocol identities, the sum was deterministically checked as 17, and the reviewer accepted.
No new login, key, paid API, broader permissions or credential transfer was used.
Blocked results identify the actual stage: prerequisites/configuration/authentication/inference/review, and retain fixed diagnostic categories only.
Remote authentication is true only after successful real official Codex inference, never because the desktop app opened or login metadata exists.

receipt_policy.if_reply_channel_unavailable: Display the sanitized receipt in the actual desktop conversation; do not obtain new account/repository permissions.
